branded.why: A well-sold brand, but one supermarket brand among many, no part of a food culture of its own.

about.text: A trademarked milder Gouda-style cheese made in Huizen by Westland Kaasspecialiteiten, in wheels of about 12 kg. It is brined for a shorter time than standard Gouda, so more whey stays in.

sources.text: Its maker, size, brining and place, from this page.
